mkdir /tmp/resource-usage
export FILE=/tmp/resource-usage/memory.txt
while true; do
  ps -u root eo pid,%cpu,%mem,args,uname --sort=-%mem >> $FILE
  echo "----------" >> $FILE
  sleep 1
done
